reviews.text: Always a perfect groom and clean, thank you!

All the way from Canada! 🇨🇦 My doggies love the treats! Thank you Josh so much for helping us and having good conversation! Absolutely pop by here and spoil your fur babies! The Mutz Nutz got everything you need! …
I’ve been coming here for years- Josh is excellent & always looks after my dogs so well.
Anazing i love the service my dog got a wonderful treat 💅.  ‼️‼️MUST SEE‼️‼️ …

My dog had a fantastic hairdo at the Mutz Nutz in Notting Hill. They turned her from a little yeti into a queen of style. It was a bit more expensive than I have paid before but now I see the compliments she’s getting I realise it was well worth the price.
Great shop, with lots of choices and the people who run it are super friendly! ❤️

All the staff at the Mutz Nuts are welcoming, friendly and helpful and Milo my fox terrier is always excited to see excellent groomer Becky when she comes to take him for his regular wash or stripping. He looks and smells divine when I come to collect him and I’m always happy with the results and attention to detail.  The shop is very well stocked, including beds, coats, collars and toys so we rarely need to go anywhere else! Highly recommended….

Best experience ever!!!
My chihuahua hates being groomed and has spent years being manhandled by vets…
Particularly when trimming his nails….
MUTZ NUTS… Have totally changed our lives for the better! They made my dog feel totally at ease, he was happy to let them do everything needed… he left 100% happy at ease and looking shiny from top to tail!

My lovely local pet store! Always friendly & a great variety of really good dog products. Ruble (the sheltie) has a sensitive tum & they have a fabulous range of very natural products that I can buy knowing he’ll be ok with them. Couldn’t recommend them highly enough!
Have been taking my dog here for years for grooming. Lovely staff and excellent and consistent grooming.  Great selection of dog gear, toys and food. Also love their dog shampoo - the best scents!
My neighborhood dog store that always has exactly what i need, the staff is so kind, and always give my dog a few treats when we go 😊🐕 …

Local shop, lovely kind customer service, no rush and knowledgeable staff good array of dog /cat toys , beautiful collars . Grooming good , wild wash dog range, lots of dog/ cat food frozen / wet and dry , lots of range of natural chews highly recommend
I've been taking my dog to The Mutz Nutz for a couple of years and I'm always super impressed! The team are all great - highly recommend!

We've been taking Elsie to The Mutz Nutz for several years now and are so happy to have found them. We had a few false starts with other groomers who didn't have the patience for a Briard (they are supposed to have long shaggy coats but one place simply shaved her as they couldn't be bothered to get the mats out!) Josh and Becky are so lovely with her - real dog-lovers and very kind and caring. She is often there for four hours and I know they give her regular breaks and water and sometimes take her out. They do exactly as I ask with her coat and we couldn't be happier.
Ordered on Deliveroo. Everytime fast and efficient

A big thank you to my local Mutz Nutz team for being such wonderful professionals! My old black Pomeranian, Marley, got a fantastic haircut and looks (and feels!) years younger. Not every groomer can handle my grumpy little pooch, but the Mutz Nutz staff were absolutely brilliant — patient, kind, and skilled. Highly recommend!
My dog is super anxious and loud, but they’re always incredibly kind and patient with her. The care they give to every pooch is truly second to none.
Josh is so lovely and makes the shopping experience so much easier
Amazing service, friendly staff and good prices.

Hello Sky and thank you for your lovely reviews. At the Mutz Nutz we work tirelessly to give our clients, both human and furry, the best experience possible so your 5 Star review is most appreciated xx

This groomer took great care of my Klee Kai! He came back squeaky clean, less shedding and perfectly done nails :) thank you! And in the middle ground price wise with a wash and tidy at £60 but I got an appointment for the same week! Happy clean dog

What a fantastic little shop! It has so many accessories, toys, leashes/harnesses, and treats! Brilliant! I'm from Paris and I'm so glad I found this little shop in a lovely London neighborhood. I highly recommend it!
Perfect paws 🐾 …
Monty has been coming  here for years! The only place in Notting Hill where he always gets the perfect groom!
Nails done in 5 min also nicest people.
Great choice of stock. Knowledgeable and very helpful.
What a beautiful shop, lots of amazing products and the staff are always so friendly and helpful. Grooming is always perfect and my dog loves it there!
I can't say enough nice things about this place.  The products are gorgeous and the staff are even nicer.  They are so helpful and never pushy.  A pleasure to visit and will certainly be back.

Cannot stress enough how amazing the mutts nutz is, staff are friendly professional and understanding. Fantastic product and value for money. Groomers are kind and caring. Have  booked Snoopy in for his next visit. He can’t wait.

Such an impressive pet store! Employees are always happy to help and very welcoming. The grooming service is very well-priced and have never had an issue with the service. They also have great pet supplies and treats that are actually good for your pets health unlike other places. Highly recommend this pet shop to any pet owners!
First class experience at mutz nutz.. cannot recommend highly enough and would honestly not go anywhere else.
Great experience and professional

I was visiting the UK recently and came across The Mutz Nutz salon in London – and I am so glad I did! They truly have the best array of products I have seen, with everything from top-quality grooming essentials to fantastic treats and toys.

From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with such warmth and friendliness by the staff at the entrance, and that level of care continued right through to the grooming team. Everyone was professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely passionate about what they do. It was clear that both the wellbeing and happiness of the pets (and their owners!) are their top priorities.

I would highly recommend The Mutz Nutz to anyone looking for outstanding products and exceptional service. I only wish I lived closer so I could visit more often!
Best pet store in Notting Hill!
One star is too many. Extortionate prices, surprised they don’t wear balaclavas
Muffin did not really line it...we loved the way they cut his hair. The dog looked sweet and jung like a puppy.
